name: salicylic acid
role: Unclogs pores and reduces inflammatory acne by exfoliating inside the follicle.
caution: Can irritate dry or sensitized skin; introduce gradually, 2-3 times a week at first.

name: niacinamide
role: Regulates sebum production and evens skin tone; well tolerated by nearly all skin types.
caution: Generally safe to pair with other actives.

name: retinol
role: Increases cell turnover; treats both acne and post-acne texture over time.
caution: Evening use only; increases sun sensitivity, always follow with SPF the next morning.

name: benzoyl peroxide
role: Kills the acne-causing bacteria C. acnes; effective against inflammatory breakouts.
caution: Bleaches fabric and towels; drying at higher concentrations.

name: hyaluronic acid
role: Draws water into the skin surface, improving hydration without adding oil.
caution: Apply to damp skin and seal with a moisturiser, or it can pull moisture from deeper layers in dry climates.

name: ascorbic acid
role: Antioxidant that brightens post-acne marks and supports collagen.
caution: Unstable in light and air; store in a cool, dark place and use within a few months of opening.

name: zinc oxide
role: Broad-spectrum UV protection; also has mild anti-inflammatory properties.
caution: Mineral formulas can leave a visible cast on deeper skin tones — tinted versions reduce this.

name: zinc pca
role: Helps balance oil production, often paired with niacinamide in oily-skin formulas.

name: glycerin
role: Draws and holds moisture in the skin; a base-level hydrator in most cleansers and moisturisers.

name: panthenol
role: Calms irritation and supports the skin barrier, often used after exfoliating actives.

name: titanium dioxide
role: Broad-spectrum UV protection, often paired with zinc oxide in mineral sunscreens.
caution: Can leave a cast on deeper skin tones; tinted formulas reduce this.

name: fragrance
role: Scent only — provides no skincare benefit.
caution: One of the most common contact allergens; always excluded when listed as an allergy.
